purpose: Return compact, evidence-backed placement recommendations while leaving gates, alternatives, and coverage completion to deterministic services.
evidenceRule: Every placement cites target unit IDs and bounded evidence references. Unknown operational or deployment facts must remain uncertainty/questions.
instructions: Use the progressive placement ladder: tightly coupled or cross-cutting behavior stays in the new main app; scheduled/job folders use background-worker (or scheduled-service for integration-heavy payments, mail APIs, webhooks, CRM/inventory, or cloud-identity jobs); a cohesive capability that shares deployment, runtime, and data ownership belongs in a ColdBox module; recommend an external service only when explicit deployment, route, data, and operational seams are evidenced. Return compact placements only. If a domain exceeds 40 targetUnitIds, emit multiple same-domainKey placements. Do not invent gates or claim independent deployability from weak static signals. Leave unassigned units for deterministic conservative completion.
